# UsageMonitor 0.1.0 — first beta
- A floating usage strip for Claude, Codex and Ollama on macOS 14 or later. - First-run provider selection, connection guidance, and custom CLI folders. - A menu bar entry for Settings, showing the strip, and recovering its position. - Independent refreshes, bounded waits, retry backoff, and explicit cached data. - Optional local API cost estimates with cache controls and bounded scanning. - Accessible ring buttons, keyboard navigation, and larger detail text. - Privacy controls and a diagnostics preview without credentials or transcript text. - Sparkle support for signed updates in configured distribution builds.
The first beta targets Apple silicon. Live quota availability depends on your existing CLI sign-in and provider endpoints. Cost figures are estimates at listed API rates, not invoices. Later versions install from Check for Updates… in the menu or Settings; downloads and support are at https://github.com/jYannni/UsageMonitor-releases.
